Banyan Tree Beach Residences Nerea

Condominium in Laguna Phuket (Bang Tao Beach)
HomeSaleBanyan Tree Beach Residences Nerea

Developer renders from the official Banyan Group Residences project page. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Nerea is a collection of just six three-bedroom duplex residences at Bang Tao Beach, within Laguna Phuket. Banyan Group Residences launched it in September 2026 as an ultra-exclusive addition to its Banyan Tree Beach Residences portfolio.

The launch material describes yacht-inspired architecture, private pools and expansive indoor-outdoor living, with Banyan Tree ownership privileges. With only six residences, it is far smaller than the other Banyan Tree Beach Residences buildings in Laguna.

A price list and completion date had not been published at the time we checked, so both are shown as on request. Message us on WhatsApp for the current price list.
